messages.author: Erdem Yeler
messages.body:
Hello amberers,
I tried to use the AMBER parallel version in docker but I couldn't make it
even if I spent hours. Is there any prepared docker version of amber? As a
temporary solution, I installed the AMBER parallel version to my wsl-ubuntu
system. Then I copied this system to my portable disk. Now I can run
AMBER-parallel on every computer without installation but it is more than 7
GB and still it is taking time to copy.  I really need it in docker.
Thanks,
Erdem
